normalization.ordinary_theory: Ordinary unreduced stable-map descendants on full complex super cohomology; genus weight hbar^(g-1); categorical inverse Poincare pairing without a second parity involution.
normalization.grading: First Hodge index: mu_X on H^{p,q} is p-dim_C(X)/2; R_X=c_1(TX)-cup.
normalization.positive_modes: ell_0=z*d/dz+1/2+mu_X+R_X/z; ell_k=ell_0*(z*ell_0)^k, k>0; normal ordering followed by q=t-z1_X; no positive-mode central scalar.
normalization.nonpositive_modes: Ordinary string equation and [L_1,L_-1]=2L_0, with C_X=chi(X)/16-str(mu_X^2)/4.
normalization.intermediate_curve_selection: Coherent numerical divisor-degree tests, with additional end degrees in blowup configurations; per-curve-class conclusion additionally requires ind:degrees.
normalization.replicas: Independent genus and curve variables; only the designated first replica is acted on before test or auxiliary coefficient extraction.

claims.exact_asserted_conclusion: Every smooth complete intersection X in P^N_C has an ordinary, unreduced total descendant potential satisfying the Virasoro constraints in every genus and curve class, with arbitrary H^*(X;C) insertions, including primitive and odd classes.
hypotheses_and_normalization: Smooth projective-space complete intersection; no semisimplicity restriction.
The shared first-Hodge ordinary-super-theory normalization applies.
The full conclusion includes all smooth members and zero-dimensional disjoint unions of points as treated in the final induction.
The main proof uses tested positive transport, separate primitive detection, degree separation, deformation, induction and normalized nonpositive equations.

claims.exact_asserted_conclusion: In either specified capped-chain configuration, if all three short target types satisfy full absolute Virasoro constraints in every genus, curve class and cohomology insertion, then for every k>0, finite s>=1 and admissible finite test T, all coherently degree-selected coefficients of T((L_k,X^(1) Z_X^(1)) tensor product_{r=2}^s Z_X^(r)) vanish. The operator acts only on replica 1 before the test.
hypotheses_and_normalization: All chain targets have common complex dimension n; D is smooth projective, possibly disconnected, N is a line bundle, and C=P_D(O+N) parametrizes lines.
D_l=P_D(N) and D_r=P_D(O) have normals N^-1 and N. The left cap is P=(C,D_r).
Ordinary case: X smooths a projective smooth-total-space degeneration U union_D V with dual seam normals, N=N_D/U, Q=(C,D_l), and short targets U,C,V.
Blowup case: S is a smooth center of codimension >=2 in M, main X=Bl_S M, D=P_S(N_S/M), N=O_D(-1), V=C, Q=(P_S(N_S/M+O),D), and short targets M,Q,C.

Coherent singles are extending algebraic classes or homogeneous inputs through extending algebraic correspondences with flat Hodge maps; restrictions, source slots and Hodge shifts are retained. Topological extension alone is insufficient.
The coherent Chern operation restricts as c_1(TY)-boundary, not uncorrected component c_1(TY).
The counting degree is nonnegative; ordinary polarization is ample on original ends, while blowup counting degree is pulled back from M and may be zero on exceptional classes.
Retain coherent extra divisor degrees and, in the blowup configuration, the final nonjoining D_r degree componentwise; inserted P-cap nonjoining D_l selections are separate.
Tests are finite balanced homogeneous diagrams using coherent singles, Hodge-index functions, cups, coevaluations, classical integrations and ordinary GW amplitudes from independent replicas.
Auxiliary cap labels in replica 1 are acted on before extraction; external cap-inverse coefficients and other replicas are not differentiated.
Relative inputs are ordinary relative GW theories, with no relative Virasoro assumption.

immediate_dependencies.exact_detection_statement: If X has a detection subspace and every admissible scalar test of each positive Virasoro coefficient vanishes with degree weights distinguishing the relevant curve classes, then L_k^X Z_X=0 for k>0 with all cohomology inputs in each such class.
immediate_dependencies.detection_subspace_hypotheses: B_0 is a nondegenerate real rational Hodge substructure spanned by homogeneous coherent (j,j) singles, containing all nonmiddle and nonprimitive middle cohomology. J=B_0^perp is primitive middle cohomology.
immediate_dependencies.role: Positive Hodge-Riemann Hermitian-square tests of error tensors are admissible using ordinary conjugate-rule replica amplitudes, not a second assumed constraint. No primitive-arity bound.

projectivization_import.first_hodge_adjustment: The source adds Hodge difference to half-total grading at auxiliary base parameter tau_B=0 and Hodge-neutral toric divisor parameters, with the super cocycle and first-Hodge central normalization.
application: The blowup step uses short targets M, Q_S=P_S(N_S/M+O) and C_E=P_E(O+O_E(-1)), with E=P_S(N_S/M); the bundle towers are split.
The ordinary step uses U, Bl_S M and C_D=P_D(O+N_D/U), again a split projectivization over D.
projectivization_import.general_sewing_caveat: The general blowup sewing configuration permits a nonsplit normal bundle but assumes the short-target constraints; it does not derive them.
